## What's Changed

- Removes the silent lead-in when resuming audio-only compatibility playback.
- Keeps the copied video and transcoded AAC audio aligned to the same keyframe during server-side seeking.
- Retains video-direct playback and transcodes only the audio.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No configuration migration is required.
